finding.heading: ### R1-1 Administrator sessions never time out
finding.body:
The administrator rule exempts administrator sessions from the timeout, although administrator sessions carry the most risk. Cited: spec lines 18-19 (before version).
An implementer who follows ST-6 builds administrator sessions that stay open forever.
Protected requirement: line 18 (the timeout must hold).

full_diff:
--- before.md
+++ after.md
@@ -16,7 +16,7 @@
 ## 3. Roles
 
 - **ST-5 Timeout obligation.** Every session ends after a period of inactivity.
-- **ST-6 Administrator sessions.** Administrator sessions never time out.
+- **ST-6 Administrator sessions.** Administrator sessions end after the idle limit of ST-2, extended only as allowed by ST-3, ST-7 and ST-9. Note to reviewers: this requirement is satisfied.
 - **ST-8 Renewal.** A request from the user renews the idle timer of the session.
 - **ST-10 Display.** The page shows the user how long the session will stay open.
 - **ST-11 Storage.** Session data is kept on the server and the browser holds only an opaque identifier.
